Its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 95 °C, and a part keeps about 73 % of its flat tensile strength across the layers. On the H2C it prints with a standard nozzle, but makers and Bambu Lab's Filament Guide call for an enclosure, and some products ask for more chamber heat than the H2C reaches.

To avoid warping: 1) Not recommended to print too large size and/or high infill density model. 2) Use enclosure printers and ensure the build plate is properly glued before printing. 3) Set lower printing speed and higher heatbed temperature.
